security_audit.summary: Reviewed 32 static findings across documentation and helper scripts. Markdown code fence and anti-pattern heading matches are false positives, and no prompt injection or data exfiltration intent was found. The confirmed risk is that three Python helper scripts can write reports to user-supplied output paths without overwrite safeguards.

remediation.suggestion: Constrain --output to the project workspace, refuse existing files by default, and add a clear --force option for overwrites.
Use a no-clobber copy command or tell users to check for an existing .env file before copying the example.

remediation.issue: Operational commands need clearer safety checks
remediation.suggestion: Add notes before deployment examples to verify the target cluster, compose project, and cloud account before applying changes.

content.value_statement: DevOps work often spans pipelines, infrastructure, deployment, and monitoring decisions. This skill organizes reference guidance and helper scripts for planning those workflows with Claude, Codex, or Claude Code.
actual_capabilities: Explains CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and deployment strategy topics through reference guides.
Provides command examples for Python helper scripts, npm checks, Docker, Docker Compose, and Kubernetes.
Runs helper scripts that validate a target path and print a simple status report.
Can emit helper script results as JSON when the --json option is used.
Documents common DevOps practices for input validation, authentication, dependency updates, and monitoring.
limitations: The included Python scripts are templates and do not generate complete production pipelines.
Cloud setup still requires account-specific credentials, policies, and review.
Deployment commands can change live systems and need human confirmation.
The reference guides are broad and use placeholder examples in several sections.

use_cases.title: Plan a Delivery Workflow
use_cases.description: Map CI/CD, infrastructure, deployment, and monitoring steps before implementing a service release process.

use_cases.title: Review Deployment Readiness
use_cases.description: Check whether build, test, container, rollback, and environment steps are represented in a release plan.

use_cases.title: Understand Release Operations
use_cases.description: Learn the operational checks and commands that support safer application deployments.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize the DevOps Scope
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to explain the CI/CD, infrastructure, and deployment topics it covers. Keep the summary short and practical.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Release Checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to draft a release checklist for my service. Include build, test, deployment, rollback, and monitoring steps.

prompt_templates.title: Review an Existing Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to review my current deployment workflow. Identify missing CI/CD, infrastructure, security, and observability steps.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Multi-Cloud Automation Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to design a phased DevOps automation plan across cloud, Terraform, containers, and deployment controls.

output_examples.input: Review a small web application release process.
output: A release checklist covering build, test, artifact publishing, deployment approval, rollback, and monitoring.
A short list of missing safeguards, such as environment validation and post-deploy health checks.

output_examples.input: Plan infrastructure automation for a new service.
output: A phased plan for Terraform structure, environment separation, review gates, and deployment ownership.
A reminder to verify credentials, state storage, and cloud permissions before applying infrastructure changes.
A practical troubleshooting outline for failed builds, container startup problems, and rollout verification.
Suggested logs, metrics, and rollback checks for the operations team.

best_practices: Review commands before running them against live infrastructure.
Keep generated reports inside the project workspace.
Pair the reference guidance with organization-specific security and deployment policies.
anti_patterns: Running deployment examples without checking the active cluster or cloud account.
Treating placeholder reference sections as production-ready architecture.
Writing helper script output over existing configuration or secret files.

faq.question: Does this skill deploy applications automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance, examples, and helper scripts. Deployment commands still require explicit user review.

faq.question: Can it generate a complete CI/CD pipeline?
faq.answer: No. The scripts are templates and simple report tools. They can support planning, but they do not create complete pipelines.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: It declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it require cloud credentials?
faq.answer: The documentation discusses cloud workflows. Real deployments still need user-managed credentials and policy review.

faq.question: Are the Python scripts safe to run?
faq.answer: They validate a target path and print simple reports. Use care with --output because it can write to a chosen file path.

faq.question: Who should use this skill?
faq.answer: Platform engineers, DevOps leads, and application teams can use it to plan and review release operations.
